title: cousinia wolgensis
intro: Cousinia wolgensis, commonly known as Wolfsbane or Bitter Wort, is a perennial plant species that belongs to the daisy family (Asteraceae). It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing relief from various health issues such as digestive problems, rheumatism, and fever. The health benefits of Wolfsbane include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as alleviate symptoms of colds and flu. The bioactive constituents of Wolfsbane include coumarins, flavonoids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including its sedative, antibacterial, and antiviral effects.
